summary: One church, St. Paul, Clifton; weekday Masses and First Friday Adoration are in the St. Mother Teresa of Calcutta Chapel in its Parish House. The weekend, weekday, Wed/Thu 7 PM and Saturday Confession times agree in both bulletins (Nov 8, Nov 15) and the website; dated Thanksgiving, Immaculate Conception and Guadalupe Masses and two cancellations are recorded. Open: which months 'except during the Summer months' covers for First Friday Adoration, and whether the Dec 12 5 AM Mañanitas is a Mass.
